jobs.jd: 🚀 Build the data layer AI needs to do science Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET About Claims AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query. We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against. The team Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer. Philipp Koellinger , CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban. Christian Roessler , co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work. Ogban Ugot , engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day. You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer. Our culture We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust. About the role Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack) Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time. Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027. We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation. This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain. You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas. Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs. Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks. Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage. Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation. Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review. Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software. Required skills and experience Typically 1–5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software. Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests. Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework. Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries. Maintain clear documentation of architecture, decisions, and interfaces for internal teams. (Bonus) Use Convex or similar BaaS / serverless data platforms for rapid product delivery. (Bonus) Build and maintain n8n workflows (webhooks, scheduled jobs, error workflows, credential management, self-hosting) to automate internal operations and connect our product stack. Strong proficiency in React , Next.js , TypeScript/JavaScript. Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads. Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management). Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus. Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team. Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively. Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools. Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process) Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. Stack Next.js (App Router) Clerk for authentication Convex for data + backend logic n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation TypeScript Requirements Public page The fictional company name is LendLoop . Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.” Show: A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex. A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk. Authenticated experience Only signed-in users can: List a tool with: name category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.) condition short description Request to borrow a tool for a date range. Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Nice, minimal layout. Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs. Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex. jobs.jd: The fastest-growing European SaaS company is searching for an AI/ML Engineer ! You can be our perfect match! About DocuSketch: DocuSketch, with its European Headquarters in Potsdam, Germany, is a leading European software technology provider for the digital real estate economy. With our product brands Immoviewer and DocuSketch, we have become one of the most successful and fastest-growing software vendors in the rapidly expanding property tech sector. Our enthusiastic customer base is located across Europe and North America. DocuSketch's groundbreaking digital technology greatly facilitates real estate companies and building restoration companies to digitize, visualize, and virtualize real estate properties. Our solutions help our clients realize tremendous cost-saving potentials, process optimization, and revenue growth. You’ll be working in a team that drives the company's AI development to develop algorithms for a variety of different use cases. This includes e.g. working with equirectangular, phone, or satellite images to detect doors, windows, or other objects inside of buildings or finding facets on the roof. You’ll be challenged by solving complex 3D geometry problems and working closely with our labeling team to ensure the best possible data quality. Responsibilities and Duties: · Research, train and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models for object detection and 3D perception on equirectangular images · Quickly prototype new ideas/technologies to create proof of concept and demos Qualifications: · Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience · Excellent math skills · Experience with 3D computer vision algorithms · Preferably 5+ years of experience developing and training machine learning models · Strong Experience with Deep ML frameworks (PyTorch) · Strong Experience in Python · Self-motivated and energetic team player with a strong work ethic and cooperative attitude · Excellent communication and organizational skills Plus: · Familiarity with building big data systems · Training very large models using multiple GPUs in the cloud · Experience with training machine learning models on equirectangular images We are seeking a performance-driven, high-energy personality who has several years of experience in the field. Since you will work intensely with teams from many countries solid command of the English language is a prerequisite. We offer attractive compensation, unlimited career opportunities, and the possibility to work in one of the most exciting software companies in the industry. The position will be remote in any location of choice in Europe (outside Russia, Belarus, and Ukraine). Our headquarters are in Berlin, Germany, with major offices in Belgrade, Serbia, Lakeland, Florida, and in Canada. We look forward to receiving your application!
